message.content:
The most visited market in New York City is **Union Square Greenmarket**.  
It’s the largest of the city’s farmers’‑market sites, drawing roughly 1 million visitors each year. The market operates Monday–Saturday from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., offering fresh produce, meats, cheeses, baked goods, flowers, and prepared foods from local growers and artisans. Its central location at Union Square and its wide variety of vendors make it a top destination for both locals and tourists.
